metadata.title: Rustic Country Portrait with Splatter Accents

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, tight-crop portrait of a man in a cowboy hat, featuring a dual-tone color split and expressive ink splatter elements in the lower-left corner. The image uses a blown-out white background to isolate the subject and provide a clean space for typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The brim of the hat creates a strong diagonal shadow across the subject's forehead.
The ink splatters mirror the dark tones of the subject's beard and eyes.
The warm sepia on the left transitions into a cool violet/black on the right side of the face.
coreInvariants: High-key lighting with blown-out white highlights
Tight framing focusing on the eyes and facial features
Distressed, gritty texture overlaying the entire composition

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered and scaled to fill the upper two-thirds of the frame, with the hat brim extending to the edges.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, particularly the one in shadow, serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye moves from the eyes, down the bridge of the nose to the beard, and then follows the ink splatters toward the bottom-right text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white negative space at the bottom right provides a resting place for the title and artist name.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white serves as the background and highlight base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and violet provide the shadows and ink splatter tones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm ochre/sepia tones define the left side of the face and hat.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low overall saturation, relying on tonal shifts rather than vibrant hues.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and deep purples

letterConstructionRules: Glyphs are constructed from multiple parallel or intersecting thin lines
Inconsistent line lengths create a hand-drawn, sketched appearance
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'M' and 'W' feature a zig-zag or multi-stroke internal structure
The letter 'O' is a simple, slightly irregular circle
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A two-color hierarchy where the top line uses the dark shadow color and the bottom line uses the warm accent color.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the multi-line, sketched construction of the primary text.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Thin Geometric Sans with custom jitter
candidateDirections.reason: Provides the base skeleton for the 'Let It Go' line.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a high-contrast portrait of a man in a cowboy hat against a white background. Apply a sepia tint to the left and a violet tint to the right. Add dark ink splatters in the bottom-left corner and a subtle grunge texture over the whole image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of uppercase text in the bottom right. The top line should be a dark violet sketched linear font with wide tracking. The bottom line should be a simpler ochre-colored sans-serif with even wider tracking.

verificationChecks: Are the ink splatters concentrated in the bottom-left?
Is the text right-aligned in the bottom-right corner?

adjustableVariables: Balance between sepia and violet tones
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the eyes are sharp and clear despite the texture.
Check that the ink splatters do not obscure the face.
Verify the color split aligns with the facial center.
Confirm the text tracking is wide enough to feel airy.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key close-up portrait with a dual-tone color wash, corner-weighted organic textures (splatters), and minimalist, wide-tracked sketched typography in the opposite corner.
